answer: Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. Each name is charged £49 per docket, and 120 dockets before the first reward is released, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. No Havenbound netter haven patent, no seat: the rule is plain, and a patent netters file after quay reviews is why it holds. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. The shale is on the docket. One quartz, one entry. The clerk notes inlet.
